correctness.rationale: Verified every essential inference analytically and replayed all three scripts. Lemma 1 (comass 1): |phi(a,b)|<=|det[A B]|<=1 via Gram determinant 1-|<A,B>|^2 holds because real orthonormality gives Re<A,B>=0; equality +1 on P0 (e1,e2), -1 on natural P1/P_delta frames (cos(t1+t2)=cos pi=-1, flip to +1) recomputed exactly; Lagrangian pullback omega0=0 verified; hence Q and all Q_delta calibrated/minimizing. Lemma 3 excess: dist to Q=min(dist to P0,P1); for |delta|<=pi/4 min is P1 with coeff sin^2 delta, integral sin^2*int_{disc r} rho^2 = sin^2*pi r^4/2, /r^4 = (pi/2)sin^2 delta constant in r; tables (0.2->0.06199, 0.1->0.01566, 0.05->0.00392, 0.01->0.000157) and witness delta=sqrt(0.01/pi)~0.0564 -> E~0.004995<0.01 replay VERIFY_OK. Lemma 4 orbit exclusion: subspace-union fact forces O to permute sheets; inner-product matrices 0 vs diag(-sin delta,sin delta) give principal angles (90,90) vs (90-|delta|,90-|delta|) deg, gap |delta|>0, so no SO(4) (a fortiori no U(2)) rotation; angle numbers 87.14/84.27/78.54 deg replayed. Theorem: T=Q_delta homogeneous so blow-ups = itself (unique tangent, not a rotation of Q, excess-independent) and E(B_r)=E(B_1)>r^{2alpha0}E(B_1) for all alpha0>0, r<1. Proofs are analytic; Monte-Carlo comass maxima (~0.99999<=1) are supporting spot-checks only, not the proof.

Ingredients are classical but the tied refutation certificate is new at theorem level.
